description: Great Britain (GB) Domestic Electricity Usage by Low Carbon Technology by Season is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ryan Jenkinson, Maria Jacob (Octopus Energy Centre for Net Zero). Important : As an research not-for-profit organisation, if you found this dataset useful we would appreciate your time in filling out this short survey. This dataset contains 3 aggregate datasets from the electricity smart meter data of over 25,000 customers in Great Britain (GB) from March 2021 - March 2022. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
